body.text: My friend Mahmoud invited me to his family dinner. He is from Iraq. I tried some falafel first. "How does it taste?" Mahmoud asked. It tasted great. So, I gave the thumbs-up sign. Mahmoud pushed my hand down. That means something rude in Iraq. "Sorry, I didn't know," I said. "It's okay. Try some lamb kebab." I grabbed some kebab with my left hand. Then, Mahmoud's grandmother smiled. She said, "Use your right hand. We think the left hand is dirty. We use it in the bathroom." That day, I learned helpful lessons about the culture of Iraq.
